why: Both analyses land on the same hedgehog (toys only, enduring classic and licensed brands, profit per brand-year), the same stop-doing core (no electronics, no unrelated ventures, separate pencils, prune the line) and all four key brutal facts. Analysis 1 is more explicit about building a successor bench and endurance independent of the son, which is the key's decline mechanism, while Analysis 2 is slightly better calibrated with its stated confidence level and its warning to decide nothing irreversible before segment data exists.
